name: dimethicone 350
uses: USES ■ helps prevent and temporarily protects and helps relieve chafed, chapped or cracked skin and lips ■ helps prevent and protect from the drying effects of wind and cold weather
otcwarn: WARNINGS: FOR EXTERNAL ONLY DO NOT USE: ON WILD OR DOMESTIC ANIMAL BITES. IF YOU HAVE AN ANIMAL BITE, CONSULT YOUR PHYSICIAN IMMEDIATELY. ON INFECTIONS FOR MORE THAN 10 DAYS. IF INFECTION WORSENS OR PERSISTS, SEE YOUR PHYSICIAN. WHEN USING THIS PRODUCT: DO NOT GET INTO EYES STOP USE AND ASK A DOCTOR IF: ​CONDITION WORSENS SYMPTONS LAST MORE THAN 7 DAYS OR CLEAR UP AND OCCUR AGAIN WITHIN A FEW DAYS
